question: Paytm SDE intern, second technical round (after questions on Kadane's algorithm, LRU cache, ACID and indexes): **What is polymorphism in OOP? Give an example.** Earlier rounds for the same candidate had also asked about the main features (pillars) of OOP, types of inheritance and access specifiers.
lookingFor: Clear definition and the two kinds of polymorphism.
A correct, relevant example in a language they know.
Connecting polymorphism to the other OOP pillars.
Awareness of inheritance types and access specifiers as related follow-ups.
followUps: What is the difference between compile-time and run-time polymorphism?
How does a virtual function work internally in C++?
Why does Java not support multiple inheritance of classes?
What is the difference between an abstract class and an interface?
